english.title: Drive a vehicle for more than 56 hour in a working week - EC
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), drove a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), for more than the fifty six hours limit in a working week, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DRIVING PERIOD..), in contravention of Article 6(2) of the Community Drivers' Hours Regulation
english.legislation: Contrary to section 96(11A) of the Transport Act 1968.

english.notes:
(i) Temporary exception during the period from 22nd January 2021 and ending with 31st March 2021: see regulation (3)(1)(b) of the Drivers' Hours and Tachographs (Temporary Exceptions) Regulations 2021, where a driver may exceed the weekly driving time by up to 4 hours.
(ii) Where the place of offence is uncertain, section 103(7) provides that the offence may be treated as having been committed at the place of driving, the person's place of residence or the principal place of business.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
